election_actions.title: Executive Order 14248 issued
election_actions.summary: The president issued an election-administration executive order. The document directs federal agencies on voter eligibility and election procedures. Current enforceability and litigation are separate, unreviewed questions.

election_actions.title: Minnesota federal and state canvass scheduled
election_actions.summary: The official results guidance schedules the State Canvassing Board for November 19. This is a future milestone as of the research date, not a certification record.

election_actions.title: President issues election executive order 14399
election_actions.summary: President Trump signed EO 14399 on March 31, directing citizenship-list work, investigation priorities and USPS rulemaking. Federal Register publication followed April 3.

election_actions.title: FCC bureau issues political-advertising rate notice
election_actions.summary: The Supreme Court’s later opinion records a March 30 FCC Media Bureau notice extending lowest-unit-charge eligibility to specified political-party and joint-fundraising activity, as well as candidates.

election_actions.title: Florida governor approves congressional map legislation
election_actions.summary: An official Senate summary states HB 1-D became law with the governor’s May 4 approval, establishing 28 districts under EOGPCRP2026 for 2026 elections.

election_actions.title: USPS publishes proposed federal ballot-mail rule
election_actions.summary: USPS published proposed ballot-mail standards on June 2, inviting public comments until July 2. This entry records a proposal, without treating it as implemented election policy.

election_actions.title: Supreme Court stays injunction against election-order provisions
election_actions.summary: The Court granted the government’s stay application concerning EO 14399 on August 24, addressing standing and ripeness. It expressly did not approve every possible implementing measure.
election_actions.actor: Supreme Court of the United States

election_actions.title: USPS publishes federal ballot-mail final rule
election_actions.summary: USPS published its final ballot-mail rule on August 26, stating an August 21 effective date and describing injunction-dependent 2026 implementation. Later nonimplementation is recorded separately.

election_actions.title: Supreme Court preserves 2022 Missouri map for 2026
election_actions.summary: The Court stayed enumerated lower-court orders on September 25 and directed that those courts not require the 2025 map or prohibit the 2022 map for Missouri’s 2026 congressional election.
election_actions.actor: Supreme Court of the United States

election_actions.title: Supreme Court stays FCC decision deadline
election_actions.summary: The Court stayed the Fourth Circuit’s October 7 order requiring an FCC decision within 48 hours. The October 14 order addresses agency timing and mandamus, without deciding electoral effects.
election_actions.actor: Supreme Court of the United States

election_actions.title: DOJ files California ballot-segregation suit
election_actions.summary: DOJ announced an October 15 complaint seeking segregation and citizenship review of ballots from people it alleged were likely noncitizens. The filing does not establish the allegation.
election_actions.actor: U.S. Department of Justice /Department of Homeland Security
election_actions.allegation_note: Noncitizenship/fraud assertions are allegations by DOJ, not reviewed findings.

election_actions.title: USPS states new ballot-mail rule will not be enforced for 2026
election_actions.summary: In an October 20 release, USPS said it was not implementing or enforcing the Ballot Mail for Federal Elections rule for the 2026 General Election.
election_actions.evidence_locator: Paragraph containing not implementing or enforcing

election_actions.title: Supreme Court stays New Hampshire election-guidance injunctions
election_actions.summary: The Court’s October 22 order stayed the district court’s October 2 and 5 preliminary injunctions pending appeal and possible certiorari. Its dissent remains distinct from the operative order.
election_actions.actor: Supreme Court of the United States

election_actions.title: DOJ initiates Alaska Senate certification case
election_actions.summary: The district court records DOJ’s October 22 filing challenging Alaska Senate certification in connection with alleged voter confusion over similarly named candidates. The alleged confusion is not adopted as fact.

election_actions.title: Ninth Circuit dismisses initial California ballot appeal
election_actions.summary: The Ninth Circuit dismissed the government’s appeal on October 26 for lack of jurisdiction because the district court had not had adequate opportunity to consider the TRO request; emergency relief was moot.
election_actions.actor: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit

election_actions.title: District court dismisses Alaska certification suit
election_actions.summary: The district court granted dismissal motions and dismissed the United States’ amended complaint without prejudice on November 1. This record does not assert that later appellate proceedings were exhausted.
election_actions.actor: U.S. District Court for the District of Alaska

election_actions.title: DOJ announces election-related prosecutions
election_actions.summary: On November 2 DOJ announced charges involving 63 individuals. This is a dated enforcement announcement; underlying allegations, offense dates, convictions and electoral effects are separate questions.

political_context.title: Election-result authority is state and local
political_context.summary: The FEC explains that state election offices certify results and that its own historical compilation is not an immediate results service. The page retains prospective wording for November 3, so its role guidance must not determine current contest finality.

political_context.title: Minnesota canvass remains scheduled
political_context.summary: The official results guidance schedules a November 19 state canvass and explains that recounts can alter totals. The transcribed federal tallies remain unofficial as of their November 9 source update.

political_context.title: Missouri boundary product warning
political_context.summary: The Census Bureau warns its 120th congressional GIS files have not yet been regenerated for Missouri’s operative 2026 plan. It says the plan remains the same as 2022/2024 and the national block-equivalency file was regenerated October 6. This is a Census product notice, not an independently reviewed court ruling.

political_context.title: Louisiana House stage requires care
political_context.summary: The FEC’s May 18 calendar identifies November 3 as Louisiana’s House primary date and December 12 as a possible runoff. These registry entries therefore do not assume that November 3 produced final general-election winners. Current state election guidance still needs review.

political_context.title: Public-service pay and service institutions
political_context.summary: The organizing PSA’s August 31 strike announcement identifies DIA, NEMA, the Ministry for Ethnic Communities, MBIE and MSD as represented workplaces. The demands and institutional targets are attributed to the union, without inferring government ideology.

political_context.title: Bogotá mobility reporting distinguishes protest and weather disruptions
political_context.summary: The city’s October 14 live account separately identifies protest-related route changes and rain-related closures. Its 6 p.m. recovery statement is a time-specific operational update; later entries report renewed closures. Neither disruption totals nor affected transport users measure protest attendance.
